articles.title: NASA's New Brainy Chip Could Let Spacecraft Think on Their Own!
articles.summary: Imagine a spacecraft that can make its own decisions millions of miles from Earth. NASA built a tiny chip 500 times smarter than today's space computers to do just that. It survived crazy tests at JPL.

articles.title: Could Time Flow Faster AND Slower at the Same Time? This Clock Might Prove It!
articles.summary: Scientists think a clock could tick fast and slow at once, like Schrödinger's cat being young and old. A new study says super-precise atomic clocks might finally show this quantum weirdness in real life.

articles.title: SpaceX's Biggest Starship Ever Is About to Blast Off!
articles.summary: SpaceX's giant Starship V3 rocket is set to launch on May 20 from Texas. It's the first flight in 7 months and will try to splash down in the Indian Ocean while dropping dummy satellites. NASA needs it for Moon landings.
